Unit 122 is a US30 twelve-versus-thirty-six return compression followed by a twelve-bar range break and twelve-bar response. It is not a threshold, window, estimator, horizon, symbol or integration successor to Unit 120 US100 realized variance or Unit 121 US500 close-location pressure.

fixed_acquisition.same_millisecond_first_tick_policy: Require each copy_ticks_range chunk to be nondecreasing by time_msc and preserve the first valid bid/ask row returned for a bar. Later rows at the same first millisecond remain measured but cannot replace the historical first-returned row; P1 parity determines whether the carrier is adequate.
fixed_acquisition.first_tick_coverage_policy: The raw carrier preserves every available first valid bid/ask row. The proxy accepts 282,761 rows whose first returned bid agrees with authoritative M5 open within USD 0.0051, rejects 92 rate-inconsistent rows, and uses the recorded M5 open/spread carrier for the resulting 1,642 uncovered bars. P1 structural parity and the fixed economic coverage envelope determine sufficiency.

fixed_signal.evaluation: At the first executable tick of each new US30 M5 bar while no observation is unresolved; after a twelve-bar resolution, the same new bar may also be evaluated for a new signal.
fixed_signal.completed_history: Current-to-immediately-completed and all 48 adjacent completed M5 bar-open deltas must each equal exactly 300 seconds.
fixed_signal.recent_returns: Twelve one-bar completed-close log returns ending at the immediately previous bar.
fixed_signal.reference_returns: The 36 one-bar completed-close log returns immediately preceding the recent twelve.
fixed_signal.volatility: Separate sample standard deviations with n-1 denominator; reference deviation must be positive.
fixed_signal.compression_ratio: recent standard deviation divided by reference standard deviation
fixed_signal.completed_range: highest high and lowest low of the immediately previous twelve completed M5 bars
fixed_signal.trigger: current first executable mid strictly above the completed range high for BUY or strictly below the completed range low for SELL, only when compression ratio is at most 0.65
fixed_signal.horizon: resolve at the first executable tick of the twelfth subsequent physical US30 M5 market bar
fixed_signal.overlap: at most one unresolved observation; the twelve-bar observation itself is the cooldown
fixed_signal.pricing_proxy: Use a rate-consistent exact first bid/ask tick when its bid equals M5 open within USD 0.0051; otherwise use M5 open as bid and recorded spread as ask distance. Observed uses entry ask/exit bid for BUY or entry bid/exit ask for SELL; doubled-spread applies one further full entry and exit spread against the direction.
fixed_signal.profit_formula: signed price distance divided by trade_tick_size times trade_tick_value times 0.01

all break directions and twelve-bar horizons equal

path_metrics: eligible continuous days, eligible compression evaluations, resolved opportunities and opportunities per eligible continuous day
observed-cost net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
double-spread net, wins, losses, profit factor, maximum closed drawdown and net-to-drawdown
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate the four ordered path books without compounding volume and calculate the same metrics plus path contribution shares.
fixed_aggregation.zero_profit: Neither win nor loss and excluded from profit-factor numerator and denominator while retained in opportunity count.

coverage_scenarios_inside_the_one_aggreg.RECORDED_SPREAD_FALLBACK: Include the one fallback-priced opportunity using M5 open bid and the recorded USD 2.10 spread at entry and resolution.
coverage_scenarios_inside_the_one_aggreg.OMIT_UNAVAILABLE_FALLBACK_OPPORTUNITY: Remove that one structurally anchored but unavailable-priced opportunity from frequency and economics.
coverage_scenarios_inside_the_one_aggreg.ZERO_SPREAD_FALLBACK_OPTIMISTIC: Include it with zero entry and resolution spread as the economic upper endpoint.
coverage_scenarios_inside_the_one_aggreg.MAX_OBSERVED_SPREAD_FALLBACK_ADVERSE: Include it with USD 321.80 entry and resolution spread, the maximum among all 282,761 rate-consistent exact first ticks, as the adverse endpoint.

fixed_frequency_gates: at least 0.25 resolved opportunities per eligible continuous day pooled
at least 0.15 resolved opportunities per eligible continuous day in at least three of four paths
fixed_economic_gates: one direction book has positive pooled double-spread net USD
its pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10
its double-spread net is positive in at least three of four paths
its pooled double-spread net divided by pooled maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50
no one path contributes more than 70 percent of the direction's total positive-path double-spread profit

decision.selection: Within each coverage scenario, select at most one passing direction by higher pooled double-spread net, then higher profit factor, then more positive paths, then lexicographic direction name. Retain a prototype only if all four scenarios select the same non-null direction. Close as economic failure only if all four select no direction. Any other combination is a coverage correction state with no research verdict.
decision.passing_action: Retain exactly one later standalone additive US30 entry-prototype question for the selected direction. Unit 122 places no trade and selects no stop, hold extension, size above 0.01, portfolio priority or Live candidate.
decision.failure_action: Close with no compression-break prototype question and no retained seed only when every coverage scenario selects no direction.
decision.coverage_disagreement_action: Keep the unit in environment correction with no research verdict; do not count the hypothesis as failed.
